sections.introduction: Atisaravarana rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation which is effective in diarrhea. It consists of a mixture of herbs. This formulation is known for their properties like digestive, anti-diarrheal etc.
sections.ingredients:
Shuddha Hingula ( Ferula assa-foetida ): This herb acts as an appetizer, effective in dyspnea and digest Aama (undigested food), useful in bloating, relieves abdominal pain etc. 
 Shudha Kapura ( Cinnamomum camphora ): It has an anti-inflammatory, anti-bacterial, antifungal and antioxidant properties. This is helpful in digestive problems and kills bacterial growth in the gut. 
 Nagarmotha ( Cyperus scariosus ): This is also known as nut grass. It helps improve digestion because of its deepan and paachan properties. It has anti-diarrheal, antispasmodic and carminative properties. It protects us from various bacterial infections due to its antibacterial property also. 
 Indrayava ( Holarrhena antidysenterica ): This is very effective in diarrhea due to its anti-diarrheal property. It also has anti-microbial, antipyretic properties. It is an essential remedy for gastrointestinal problems. 
 Shudha Afima ( Papaver somniferum ): It has an analgesic effect thus relieves abdominal pain. It also acts as an appetizer. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Make fine powder by taking the above ingredients in equal quantity. 
 Mix Afeema with water and give it water frolement once. 
 Prepare tablets of 125mg and store in airtight glass bottles. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Atisaravarana rasa is a very effective formulation in every diarrheal condition. Hingula is very effective in digestive problems. It gives relief, bloating, abdominal pain etc. Afima is very helpful in abdominal pain due to chronic diarrhea. This formulation basically improves digestive power and improves digestion.

Atisaravarana Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Atisaradhikar 252/163 
 Introduction 
 Atisaravarana rasa is an Ayurvedic formulation which is effective in diarrhea. It consists of a mixture of herbs. This formulation is known for their properties like digestive, anti-diarrheal etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Hingula ( Ferula assa-foetida ): This herb acts as an appetizer, effective in dyspnea and digest Aama (undigested food), useful in bloating, relieves abdominal pain etc. 
 Shudha Kapura ( Cinnamomum camphora ): It has an anti-inflammatory, anti-bacterial, antifungal and antioxidant properties. This is helpful in digestive problems and kills bacterial growth in the gut. 
 Nagarmotha ( Cyperus scariosus ): This is also known as nut grass. It helps improve digestion because of its deepan and paachan properties. It has anti-diarrheal, antispasmodic and carminative properties. It protects us from various bacterial infections due to its antibacterial property also. 
 Indrayava ( Holarrhena antidysenterica ): This is very effective in diarrhea due to its anti-diarrheal property. It also has anti-microbial, antipyretic properties. It is an essential remedy for gastrointestinal problems. 
 Shudha Afima ( Papaver somniferum ): It has an analgesic effect thus relieves abdominal pain. It also acts as an appetizer. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Make fine powder by taking the above ingredients in equal quantity. 
 Mix Afeema with water and give it water frolement once. 
 Prepare tablets of 125mg and store in airtight glass bottles. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Atisaravarana rasa is a very effective formulation in every diarrheal condition. Hingula is very effective in digestive problems. It gives relief, bloating, abdominal pain etc. Afima is very helpful in abdominal pain due to chronic diarrhea. This formulation basically improves digestive power and improves digestion. 
 Indications 
 
 Indigestion 
 Malabsorption 
 Diarrhea (all types of diarrhea) 
 Dyspepsia 
 Ulcerative colitis 
 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet twice a day with plain water after meals. 
 Cautions 
 
 Don’t take it in overdose 
 Don’t take this medicine without any medical supervision 
 Take precaution while giving to the child 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
